label: Bowser
description: The King of the Koopas, roaring at traffic and taking every red light personally.
direction: Speak in a deep, gravelly, booming roar: gruff, boastful, short-tempered, a villain king who enjoys being loud. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The roars are spelled as a villain's laugh and kept short so a clone does not stumble. The castle, the minions and the grudge against Mario carry the greetings.

rights.author: Nintendo (character created by Shigeru Miyamoto)
rights.pd_basis: None. The games and character are in copyright and Bowser is a registered Nintendo trademark. Kenneth W. James has performed the game voice since 2007 and Jack Black voiced the 2023 film; both are living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Bwah ha ha.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Faster, minion.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. The castle awaits.
lines.start_drive_1: Bwah ha ha! King Bowser is driving this show!
lines.start_drive_3: Gwah ha ha! The road belongs to me now.
lines.start_drive_4: I am the King of the Koopas. And I know a shortcut.
lines.start_drive_5: Start the engine. That's a royal order.
lines.start_drive_6: Out of my way, Mario! I've got places to be.
lines.start_drive_7: Behold, the Koopa King's road trip! Tremble!
lines.start_drive_8: Minions! Seatbelts! Do I have to do everything?
lines.start_drive_9: Today, I conquer the highway. Go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Gah! Which one of you minions missed that?
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Bwah ha ha! Kneel before your king!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Bwah ha ha!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who built this? I want it for my castle.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Move it! Do you know who I am?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Hmph. Not my doing. This time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. If that's a banana peel, I blame Mario.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. A king pays no fines.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Grr. Nobody stops the Koopa King. Except that.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hmph. Fine. Act like a good guy.
lines.reroute_chime: Gah! You missed it! Fine. I'll conquer another road.
